title: Elucidating substituent effects in magnetic properties of redox active cobalt complexes and testing them as potential catalysts for HER
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,19287-19294
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01958C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Sriram Sundaresan, Julia Müller, Luca M. Carrella, Eva Rentschler
We report the synthesis of three cobalt complexes (C1–C3) with redox-active catechol ligands and a tetradentate salen ligand (Lsal). Their magnetic properties were studied, and the complexes were also evaluated for electrocatalytic HER activity.
